downloads.title: Offline Packs & Plugins
downloads.intro_desc: Download offline map tiles, local SLM AI model weights, execution engines, and regional language packs directly to device cache for 100% offline emergency preparedness.
downloads.map_desc: High-contrast OpenStreetMap vector tiles with rivers, embankments, elevation contours, and safe evacuation paths.
downloads.slm_desc: On-device fine-tuned Small Language Model for offline disaster inquiries, well chlorination formulas, and safety invariants.
downloads.py_desc: Enables local execution for empirical reach lag distributions, wave propagation models, and telemetry backtesting.
downloads.py_guidance_desc: Runs local Python 3.11 telemetry fetcher and hydrologic model engine on localhost:8000.
downloads.lang_desc: Offline disaster vocabulary, Devanagari & Gurmukhi script fonts, and pre-translated emergency cards. English is built-in default.
